title: Conductor OSS Telemetry Payload
description: Complete, authoritative schema for the opt-in telemetry payload Conductor sends once per version. See TELEMETRY.md. No field outside this schema is ever collected or sent.

schema_version.description: Payload schema version. Bumped on any change to this schema.

instance_id.description: Random UUID generated once and stored locally. Not derived from hostname/IP/hardware; not linkable to identity.

cluster_id.description: Reserved. Optional shared identifier to collapse multi-node clusters into one deployment. Open question in the proposal; null in v1.

email.description: Present ONLY if the user explicitly provided one via a separate, independent opt-in. Absent/null for stats-only installs.

max_heap_mb.description: Runtime.maxMemory() rounded to the nearest 1024 MB to avoid fingerprinting.

modules.description: Active backend modules. Values are the raw conductor.* property values (the type strings the operator configured). Free strings rather than enums so new backends don't break validation of older payloads; known values are listed per field.

db_type.description: conductor.db.type. Known: cassandra, mysql, postgres, sqlite, redis_standalone, redis_cluster, redis_sentinel, memory.

queue_type.description: conductor.queue.type. Known: redis_standalone, redis_cluster, redis_sentinel, postgres, mysql, sqlite.

indexing_type.description: conductor.indexing.type; 'none' when conductor.indexing.enabled=false. Known: elasticsearch (legacy v7), elasticsearch8, opensearch2, opensearch3, postgres, sqlite, none.

event_queue_type.description: conductor.default-event-queue.type; 'none' if no external event queue is enabled. Known: kafka, amqp, sqs, nats, nats_stream, jsm, none.

external_payload_storage.description: conductor.external-payload-storage.type — offload store for large workflow/task payloads. 'none' = DummyPayloadStorage (default when unset). Known: s3, azureblob, postgres, none. ('mock' is test-harness-only and never reported.)

file_storage.description: conductor.file-storage.type — the newer file-storage subsystem (conductor.file-storage.enabled defaults to false). 'none' when disabled (the default). Known: none, conductor, s3, azure-blob, gcs.

scale.description: All fields are coarse buckets. Exact counts and rates are never sent.

server_nodes.description: Bucketed count of Conductor server nodes. Non-overlapping ranges.

workflow_defs.description: Bucketed count of workflow definitions (count only; names are never sent). Order-of-magnitude, non-overlapping.

task_defs.description: Bucketed count of task definitions (count only; names are never sent). Order-of-magnitude, non-overlapping.

workflows_started_bucket.description: Bucketed workflows started per day. Order-of-magnitude, non-overlapping.

avg_queue_depth_bucket.description: Bucketed average task queue depth. Order-of-magnitude, non-overlapping.
